lyrics:
“Sky View”

(Southern Soul / Country Soul Ballad – mid-tempo, reflective and uplifting)

Verse 1

We started out young, just a boy and a girl

I said, “Come take a chance with me, I’ll show you the world.”

Dreams deferred, but never denied

Hand in hand, we took that ride.

Through the struggles, through the storms we came

Built our life, and carried our name.

Chorus

Now we got a sky view — looking back at where we’ve been

From the dirt roads to the bright lights, again and again.

Blessed with two girls, now they’re standing tall

Watching daddy Singing Southern Soul music, answering the call.

From the highs to the lows, we rise above

That’s our story — built on faith and love.

Yeah, that’s our sky view.

Verse 2

Remember those nights when the bills came due

We prayed for a blessing, and we made it through.

Kept believing when times got tight

You held me close through every fight.

Now when they me shining on that stage

I know their love turned another page.

Chorus

Now we got a sky view — looking back at where we’ve been

From the dirt roads to the bright lights, again and again.

Blessed with two girls, now they’re standing tall

Daddy Singing Southern Soul music, answering the call.

From the highs to the lows, we rise above

That’s our story — built on faith and love.

Yeah, that’s our sky view.

Bridge

Every sunset, every dawn

Shows how far we’ve come along.

If love’s a mountain, we climbed it too

And the view up here — it’s me and you.

Final Chorus / Outro

We got that sky view — dreams that came true

A family, a legacy, just me and you.

From the highs to the lows, we rise above

Still standing strong, still in love.

Yeah, that’s our sky view...

That’s our sky view.
